sentence: This project builds a small, portable chemical analyzer that uses an ion trap mass analyzer.
This project builds tools that add genes to and edit the genome of einkorn wheat.
This project builds networks that connect quantum devices over long distances using quantum repeaters.
This project builds a method to find proteins that bind RNA carried between cells in tiny particles called extracellular vesicles.
This project uses mathematics to study how cells split into two lineages as they develop, using data from stem cells.
This project builds graph neural networks on specialized chips to choose useful particle collisions in real time.
This project studies whether the organic matter that microbes eat in glacier water comes from ancient carbon or from modern microbes.
This project uses mathematical proofs to show that computer systems that make and analyze images and videos behave correctly.
This project builds a web service that lets scientists train deep learning models without having to manage the computing resources.
This project sets up a scanning electron microscope that looks at the structure and chemistry of many kinds of materials.
This project studies ways to collect fewer data points in nuclear magnetic resonance measurements so they take less time.
This project uses machine learning to build fast models that predict how well computer networks perform.
This project uses artificial intelligence to predict which catalysts will work well for ethylene reactions before any experiments are run.
This project builds a web-based virtual environment for learning to use robotic 3D printing in construction.
This project builds computer models that help robots understand what people intend during physical and social interactions.
This project holds a conference on how to combine artificial intelligence and machine learning with careful reasoning in statistics.
